translation:
The jaundice condition, body yellow, is not pleasing to look at; yellow-sweat (huanghan) and jaundice (huangdan) and many others. Though of wine, grain, and women's-labor there be five, drain water and harmonize the middle are the two ends.
Much is from soups and drinks stopping the urination; the middle jiao damp-heat is the pressing pass. Yinchen Tang (Artemisia Capillaris Decoction) can return the mandate of heaven; in the turning of an eye the rosy cheek plays at joy.

Yinchen Tang (Artemisia Capillaris Decoction)
Yinchen (Artemisia capillaris) exclusively treats the five jaundices; Huangqin (Scutellaria), Lian (Huanglian/Coptis), Zhu (Atractylodes), Gancao (Licorice) and Longdan (Gentian). Zhuling, Zexie, Zhi (Zhizi/Gardenia) and Qingpi; expelling and driving the damp-heat, truly brave.
translator_notes: 五疸=the five jaundices (yellow-sweat, wine, grain, women's-labor, jaundice).
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）

translation:
In fatigue-injury and consumptive loss, supplementation is made lord; the myriad methods and thousand formulas treat them not the same. Speak out plainly the principle of the five agents generating and overcoming; the replete and deficient of blood and qi, one must know.
Qi deficiency does not step outside Four-Gentleman (Sijunzi); blood deficiency, Four-Substances (Siwu) is what should be followed. Liuwei Dihuang (Six-Flavor Rehmannia) harmonizes small fire; Tianwang Buxin (Heavenly-King Nourish-the-Heart) each one unblocks.
translator_notes: 四君子湯/四物湯=Sijunzi/Siwu; 六味地黃丸=Liuwei Dihuang Wan; 天王補心丹=Tianwang Buxin Dan.
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）

translation:
Consumptive fatigue (xulao), commonly called timid-fatigue, much is from over-induction of wine and sex, too burnt. Palms and soles hot, phlegm making cough; spermatorrhea, sweat-rain and hemoptysis in plenty.
The whole body moreover issues steaming fever; the true yin is consumed and scorched, falling off the skin and hair. Consumptive transmission (laozhai) has worms able to transform; nourishing by fumigation and transmitting contagion, it rides the deep chronic ailment.
Of the name and colors, hard to distinguish the five, six or seven; fine, tiny, soft and weak, the pulse is hard to escape. Treating timidity, one must nourish yin and descend fire; when the flesh falls off, how does the dragon elixir help?
Ziyin Jianghuo (Nourish-Yin and Descend-Fire) with Bai (Huangbai/Phellodendron) and Zhi (Zhimu/Anemarrhena) all complete; two-dehuang/Rehmannia (Shengdi-Shudi) with Chuanxiong, Dang Gui and Maimen (Ophiopogon). Gancao (Licorice), Chenpi, Baishao and Zhu (Atractylodes); one cup poured down, it quells the burning plain.
translator_notes: 虛勞=consumptive fatigue (weakness fatigue); 勞瘵/傳屍=consumption with worms (tuberculosis-like wasting).
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）
